name: Mao
description: Mao is a unique card game known for its extreme secrecy and metagame elements. It is the most famous of the 'secret rule' games, where the only rule that may be explained to a new player is: 'The rules of Mao cannot be told.' New players must learn the rules through trial and error, as they are penalized (by drawing cards) for every infraction. Each winner of a round also gets to create a new secret rule for the next round, meaning the game evolves indefinitely.

Its exact origin is shrouded in mystery, intentional or otherwise. It appeared in various US university campuses in the 1960s and 70s.
Two shuffled standard decks. All cards face down.

Each player is dealt 7 cards. Players CANNOT look at their cards until the game officially starts.

items.text: Dutch Mao: Each player invents one rule at the start; no standard matching rules. Also known as The People's Democratic Dictatorship.
Hand size: Initial hand is three cards in some variants, seven in others.
Winner adds rule: Winner of each round adds one secret rule for the next round; often only dealer knows it.
